name: blood-cells-flow
description: Red blood cells flowing through a vessel - procedural Three.js / WebGL 2 composition for Remotion (4K, 30 fps)

scripts.render:v1: remotion render BloodCells-V1 "out/Version 1 - Blood Cells Flow (1080p).mp4" --scale=0.5
scripts.render:v2: remotion render BloodCells-V2 "out/Version 2 - Blood Cells Flow (1080p).mp4" --scale=0.5
scripts.render:v1:4k: remotion render BloodCells-V1 "out/Version 1 - Blood Cells Flow (4K).mp4"
scripts.render:v2:4k: remotion render BloodCells-V2 "out/Version 2 - Blood Cells Flow (4K).mp4"
scripts.render: npm run render:v1 && npm run render:v2
scripts.render:4k: npm run render:v1:4k && npm run render:v2:4k
